title: Nice Looking Coat Rack
text:
Nice Looking Coat Rack. I really like this next to our front door. It was pretty easy to put together and it seemed rugged enough for its job. It did a great job of organizing shoes and jackets at our front door that otherwise lacked a closet and proved less tippy than I feared.

However, while moving, one of the movers put some horizontal pressure on the coat rack and it cracked the wooden rod at the bolt in the bottom. We ended up using just the bottom in a closet after that to organize the kids shoes. I think if it had not been for the move this would have held up, but it may be a little over priced for the quality.

product_metadata.title: Adesso Hutch Storage Coat Rack, Walnut
features: MDF with PVC Veneer- Natural and Walnut Finish
Fabric type: Rubber Wood 7% Particle Board 93%
description: An organizational solution for a small space, or a way to tidy up the entry way in style, the Hutch Storage Coat Rack provides 4 functional coat hooks as well as 3 storage cubbies. A convenient place to store shoes or accessories, this storage piece allows for easy access on the way out the door. Mixing natural and walnut wood finishes, this Hutch Storage Coat Rack is not only super functional, but can fit into a variety of different room decors with style.

details.Warranty Description: Defective parts will be replaced by manufacturer as available.
